blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: attribute — Descriptive field of an entity.
foreign key — Reference to key in another table.
index — Search aid on selected columns.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: An entity corresponds to a distinguishable object type; a relational table stores rows of its attributes.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: A primary key uniquely identifies each row; foreign keys express references from related tables.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: A secondary/index key can accelerate searching without necessarily being unique. One-to-many relationships use a foreign key on the many side.
